edges.rationale: The first sentence says reduced inflammatory activity was followed by slower fibrosis progression.
Equal antifibrotic effects with and without measurable inflammatory response are presented as evidence that inflammation reduction was not necessary.
The paragraph uses temporal precedence to support the exclusive inflammatory mechanism, but precedence alone provides only weak structural support for that conclusion.
Inflammation declining before fibrosis improves does not by itself prove mediation or exclude alternative pathways.
If inflammation reduction is not necessary for benefit, benefit cannot occur exclusively through inflammation suppression.
An equal antifibrotic effect in patients without a measurable inflammatory response conflicts with the asserted exclusive inflammatory pathway, as framed by the paragraph itself.

issues.title: Exclusive-mechanism conclusion conflicts with the stated lack of necessity
issues.explanation: The paragraph first says inflammation reduction was not necessary for benefit, then says fibrosis prevention occurs exclusively through inflammation suppression. An exclusive pathway would require that pathway to be necessary.
issues.logical_pattern: Not necessary for benefit ∧ exclusively through that pathway.
issues.suggested_revision: Remove the exclusivity claim or reconcile it with the reported benefit among patients without a measurable inflammatory response.

issues.title: Temporal precedence is treated as proof of an exclusive causal mechanism
issues.explanation: The stated premise establishes that inflammation declined before fibrosis improved. It does not, on its own, prove that inflammation suppression caused the fibrosis benefit or that no other pathway contributed.
issues.logical_pattern: A precedes B ⇒ A is proven to be the exclusive cause or mediator of B.
issues.suggested_revision: State that the temporal sequence is consistent with a possible inflammatory pathway, without claiming proof or exclusivity.
validation_reasons: 관련 Node 사이에 구조적 관계가 존재하지만 현재 규칙만으로 결론을 확정하지는 못합니다.
